items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: Homer Simeon, the same way, his father went up as a cigar maker.

ctx.x: They did all that cigar making business and that. No, he used to work in the office for Dennis.
Homer Simeon, the same way, his father went up as a cigar maker.
Yeah, most of all those Creole fellas, they went up there and made cigar and things like that.
